findings.message: This writes to `a`, which is declared outside the component or hook, while the component is rendering. Render has to be able to run at any time and any number of times, so a write that escapes it makes the result depend on how often the component happened to render. Under Strict Mode and concurrent rendering that count is not something the code controls, so the value drifts and the bug shows up somewhere else entirely. If the value is used in rendering, hold it in useState. If it is not, write it from an effect or an event handler, where running once is guaranteed.
